newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian forex market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Australian forex market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Australian foreign exchange market was closed on Monday for the Queen's Birthday holiday.

The local dollar finished Friday on a steady but subdued note as all attempts to get a recovery going were frustrated by offshore offers. By 4.45 p.m. (0645 GMT) the local currency had deflated to US$0.7591/96, having ventured as high as US$0.7617 in the morning from US$0.7575/80 late on Thursday.
On the crosses it lost an early bounce to end little changed at 87.80/90 yen, having slipped from 8.40/50 on Thursday.
